ctx.x: Yes, Williams Air Force Base in Williams, Arizona. We played the officer's club and we went in and the fans, they were practically hugging and kissing you but when we got through with the dance, everything was closed on the base, so we came on through in the little town and found us an all-night cafe, so we walked in and sat down.
